lesson: The trade failed because the breakout above 82.00 acted as a liquidity trap rather than a structural shift, leading to a rapid reversal. The system incorrectly prioritized short-term bullish structure over the broader HTF bearish context, resulting in a low-probability long entry.
adjustment: Require a confirmed retest of the breakout level as support on the 4H timeframe before entering, rather than entering on the initial breakout candle.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps more than breakout-based trend following on SOLUSDT.
